task.title: Testing plug-ins against several DITA-OT versions
task.shortdesc: A continuous integration (CI) matrix runs the same plug-in tests once for each DITA-OT version that the plug-in supports. With the Gradle build from , each entry in the matrix passes a different DITA-OT version to the build.

prereq.p: A Gradle build that tests the plug-in, such as the sample in , in a repository on GitHub.

context.p: A plug-in that works on one DITA-OT release can fail on another, for example when a core template or parameter changes. Testing every supported version on each change shows which versions a change breaks. It also shows whether the plug-in works with a new release before you announce support for it.
This example uses . Other CI systems can run the same Gradle command.

step.cmd: In build.gradle.kts, read the DITA-OT version from a Gradle property, with a default for local builds.

stepxmp.p: The sample build uses ditaOtVersion in three places: the version that downloadDitaOt downloads, the installation that installPlugin and validateDita use, and the output directory of buildSampleHtml5.

step.cmd: Include the DITA-OT version in the output directory of each transformation task.

info.p: If two versions write to the same output directory, Gradle can consider the second transformation up to date and skip it. The build then reports success for a version that it did not test.

step.cmd: Run the build locally for two versions, to confirm that the version is passed through.

stepresult.p: The build/output directory contains one output directory for each version.

step.cmd: Add a workflow file to the .github/workflows directory of the plug-in repository.

ul.li: strategy.matrix.dita-ot-version lists the DITA-OT versions to test. GitHub starts one job for each value.
fail-fast: false lets the other versions finish when one fails, so that you see all the failing versions at once.
The run step passes the version to Gradle with -PditaOtVersion=${{ matrix.dita-ot-version }}.
The last step uploads the output and the plug-in ZIP file for each version, even when the tests fail, so that you can inspect them.

step.cmd: Edit the dita-ot-version list to match the DITA-OT versions that your plug-in supports.

info.p: Each value must be a released DITA-OT version number, such as 4.4.2.

stepresult.p: The workflow runs on each push and pull request. In the Actions tab of the repository, each DITA-OT version appears as a separate job, named after the version.

postreq.p: When a new DITA-OT version is released, add it to the matrix before you announce support for it. Remove a version when you stop supporting it. See .
